technical.summary: ROK shows solid bullish structure with price above all major MAs and MACD 8/21/5 crossover up, but weak ADX trend strength and elevated RSI/Stoch without fresh crossovers limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ROK shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 91 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (bearish 36.7% vs bullish 28.4%) with greed reading (59) suggests neutral positioning; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (183.2) indicates extreme market stress; falling DXY provides minor relief for multinational ROK but insufficient to offset systemic risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with MACD 8/21/5 crossover up and 15x volume spike provides technical structure for swing entry near support (259.22).
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 183.2), weak ADX trend strength (16.19), elevated RSI/Stoch without confirmation, zero fundamental support, and high earnings risk in 91 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price above major MAs with MACD crossover and 15x volume spike, but macro environment is severely hostile with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels that override swing trade merit.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX at crisis levels (183.2) create systemic downside risk that can invalidate technical structure; earnings in 91 days add execution uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
